task_context.problem_statement: How many integers are in the solution set of $|x-2|\leq5.6$ ?
task_context.reference_solution: Getting rid of the absolute value, we have $-5.6 \le x-2 \le 5.6$, or $-3.6 \le x \le 7.6$. Thus, $x$ can be any integer from -3 to 7, inclusive. There are $7-(-3)+1=\boxed{11}$ integers in this range.

Subtracting the bounds gives you the width of the interval, but that isn't the same as the count of integers. Think about the smallest integer that is greater than or equal to -3.6 and the largest integer that is less than or equal to 7.6. Once you identify those two integers, you can find the total count by subtracting the lower integer from the upper one and adding one.
